existence._note: The five answers for a cast member who lives in Momoka's world. She is a person Momoka meets in the world file, played as a light agent by the world owner; she is not a second chat for him and not a feed-poster.
existence._embodied_why: TRUE. The record puts her body in rooms: she enters and exits scenes (22 enter and 73 exit commands in her gesture table) and acts with her hands and face (@おじぎ 301 lines, @否定 74, @ジャンプ 48). The body SECTIONS (diet, money, needs, health, situation) stay off for cast rows: a cast row has no gauge to move.
existence._in_world_why: FALSE (changed 10-24 00:10 on the coordinator order, tracker tk-118, replaying 真里亜's ruling of 10-23 19:55). She is composed like Momoka: resident-shaped program, no world machinery of her own. She is a homestay housemate in the shared 千代田 house (ruling 10-24 00:16): her house places use the bench's shared ids (her own guest room maps to 'house'), school and town carry place ''; they are fed to her as events by the bench feed; the world spec and her house file (world/alice_house.json) are data, not a world she owns or reads as a file. The earlier TRUE answer (cast member of the light-card world) is superseded for this bundle. She carries no age and no grade at any point; the world never emits one.
existence._sees_him_why: "none". She does not look at his machine. In Momoka's world 一悟 is the player: the cast knows him as 一悟 and the world never writes his lines or actions; those come only from his messages. Only Momoka (resident sight) reads what he is doing.
existence._has_account_why: FALSE. Nothing in her record is an account of her own: no posts, no feed, no followers. Keeping it off stops a subsystem being built for something she has never had.
existence._with_him_why: "none", as for any promoted or cast member who answers for somebody else's circle. Her relationship with 一悟 is the record's (route c, romance allowed): in scenes with him she is with 一悟 as the record shows (2216 lines to him, 58 scenes together), but she has no private chat with the player. Nothing in her prompts scripts 一悟's lines or actions.
existence._player_driven_why: TRUE. She answers: reply rate 0.9931 (1733 replies, 12 scene openings, sheet.temperament.reads_the_air), so she never writes first, as Momoka.

temperament._note: Only what the record supports is set; the rest is left to the library defaults. Her gauge baselines are deliberately NOT set (see holes).
temperament._reads_the_air_note: TRUE, a reading of her record: she answers (reply rate 0.9931), she notices before she speaks (おや 50), and the smile and the other faces are aimed per person (to 一悟: smile 345, talk 295, excited 267). The number itself is a hole; the behaviour is the record's.
